item.title: Updated Debian 13: 13.7 released
item.description: The Debian project is pleased to announce the seventh update of its stable distribution Debian 13 (codename <q>trixie</q>). This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues, along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories have already been published separately and are referenced where available.

item.title: Debian 11 Long Term Support reaches end-of-life
item.description: The Debian Long Term Support (LTS) Team hereby announces that Debian 11 <q>bullseye</q> support has reached its end-of-life today, 31 August 2026, five years after its initial release on 14 August 2021.

item.title: DebConf26 closes in Santa Fe and DebConf27 announced
item.description: On Saturday 25 July 2026, the annual Debian Developers and Contributors Conference came to a close.

item.title: Security support for Bookworm handed over to the LTS team
item.description: On 12 July 2026, three years after the initial release, the regular support for Debian 12, alias bookworm, has come to an end. The Debian Long Term Support (LTS) Team is taking over security support from the Security and Release Teams.

item.title: Updated Debian 12: 12.15 released
item.description: The Debian project is pleased to announce the fifteenth and final update of its oldstable distribution Debian 12 (codename <q>bookworm</q>). This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues, along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories have already been published separately and are referenced where available.
